title: Bellman optimality Grid World lab
description: Inspect maximizing backups, complete greedy ties, propagation, and model sensitivity in the shared 4×4 environment.
ready: Optimality engine ready. Inspect the current operator image or apply one synchronous sweep.
working: Rust is computing synchronous Bellman optimality backups.
failed: The optimality engine could not start. The static model and golden values remain available below.
resetDone: Values and propagation history were reset to V₀ = 0.
converged: Reached the fixed-point tolerance after {sweep} sweeps; residual {residual}.
limitReached: The sweep limit was reached before the residual entered tolerance.
mapTitle: Current value map and greedy requests
mapBody: Select any state. Every tied maximizing request is retained as an arrow and text label; colors only summarize value magnitude.
stateAria: State s{state}, {kind}; current value {value}; reference value {reference}; greedy requests {actions}
numericTable: Numeric values and greedy requests for all 16 states
backupsBody: Each q row first averages every actual wind outcome for one requested action. Only then does T* take the maximum across the five requested actions.
ledgerBody: These rows stay inside one requested action. Their weighted contributions sum to its q value; an actual wind direction is never maximized separately.
terminalNoActions: The terminal goal has no outgoing decision row and remains fixed at zero.
lastUpdate: Latest committed update for s{state}: {oldValue} → {newValue}; absolute change {delta}.
propagationBody: The residual shown after each commit is ‖T*Vₖ − Vₖ‖∞ for that current vector. The table is the numeric alternative to the logarithmic trace.
historyAria: Bellman optimality residual by synchronous sweep
historyDescription: A logarithmically scaled line shows the residual at the initial vector and after every completed sweep. The adjacent table lists the exact plotted numbers.
noCommittedSweep: Apply one sweep to compare the update that produced a vector with that vector’s current residual.
contractionBody: For consecutive synchronous images under the same applied operator, the current residual cannot exceed γ times the maximum update that produced the current vector.
witnessEquation: current residual ≤ γ × latest maximum update
factorsBody: Change one field or load a preset, then apply it. Rust rebuilds both the live operator and its high-precision reference from the shared transition model.
factorStatesChanged: States whose current greedy set differs from the fresh reference: {count}
auditBody: The presentation independently recomputes structural invariants from the Worker snapshot and transition ledger.
auditRows: Every nonterminal state–requested-action probability row sums to one
auditTerminal: s15 has no decision row, value zero, and no greedy action
auditFinite: All model rewards, values, action values, and residuals are finite
auditActionSums: Every q value equals the sum of outcomes within its requested action
auditGreedy: Every greedy mask contains all and only tied requested-action maxima
auditResidual: Displayed residual equals the maximum current action backup gap
auditReference: The high-precision reference has negligible residual
auditContraction: The latest residual satisfies the one-step γ bound
errorPrefix: The optimality engine rejected the command.

errors.optimality_discount_range: The discount factor must be finite and between 0 and 0.99.
errors.optimality_slip_range: Wind probability must be finite and between 0 and 1.
errors.optimality_tolerance_range: Tolerance must be finite, greater than 0, and no greater than 1.
errors.optimality_max_sweeps_range: Maximum sweeps must be an integer from 1 through 10,000.
errors.optimality_reward_range: Every reward must be finite with magnitude at most 1,000,000.
errors.optimality_restore_sweeps: The stored sweep count is outside the configured limit.
errors.optimality_advance_sweeps: The internal sweep batch is outside its safe limit.
errors.worker_error: The experiment Worker reported an unexpected error.
